props.name: children
props.comment: The value, usually a server field over the same record.

props.name: className
props.comment: A class name to apply to the field wrapper.

props.name: label
props.comment:
The label, as a message key: translated through `i18n` when one is given,
printed as is otherwise.

props.name: variant
props.comment: `stacked` puts the label above the value, `inline` beside it. Default `stacked`.
